questions.meaning: What would you like help with today?
questions.ask_only_when: Clarify goal only if explicit intent is insufficient for the requested help.
questions.unknown_effect: Education/browsing can continue; do not invent a goal.
questions.product_responsibility: Requested task, beneficiary and contextual explanation; familiarity never changes fit.

questions.meaning: How familiar are you with Medicare?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask optionally if familiarity would improve the explanation.
questions.unknown_effect: No factual availability, candidate, fit or ranking gate.
questions.product_responsibility: Requested task, beneficiary and contextual explanation; familiarity never changes fit.

questions.meaning: What ZIP code do you live in?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask missing ZIP/county only for a geography-dependent requested check; reuse RC02.
questions.unknown_effect: Geographic finding remains unscoped; no inferred county/residency.
questions.product_responsibility: Scope available facts to exact year/geography; preference is not entitlement.

questions.meaning: When do you need Medicare coverage to start?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask desired timing only when it changes the requested check; soonest is a preference.
questions.unknown_effect: No inferred month, effective date, eligibility anchor or deadline.
questions.product_responsibility: Scope available facts to exact year/geography; preference is not entitlement.

questions.meaning: What health coverage do you have now?
questions.ask_only_when: Reuse current coverage reports; clarify consequential subtype/period only.
questions.unknown_effect: Keep partial positives and missing baseline; no inferred A/B or absence.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: Which doctors or hospitals would you like to keep?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask only requested provider needs; reuse known names and distinguish explicit none from unknown.
questions.unknown_effect: Unknown list is not no providers; listing a name is not a hard constraint.
questions.product_responsibility: Exact provider/site identity then separately sourced participation and access.

questions.meaning: What prescriptions do you take?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask medicines only for a requested care/coverage comparison; reuse existing items.
questions.unknown_effect: Unknown list is not no medicines; partial items stay partial.
questions.product_responsibility: Product identity, formulary conditions and only relevant fill/store/administration details.

questions.meaning: Will you need routine care away from home?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask only if routine-away-care needs could change the requested comparison.
questions.unknown_effect: Do not assume no travel, a location, or emergency evidence implies routine coverage.
questions.product_responsibility: Routine versus emergency care and relevant places/periods.

questions.meaning: How would you prefer to balance monthly payments and costs when you get care?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask optionally if the person wants to express this tradeoff.
questions.unknown_effect: No invented risk tolerance, numerical weights or cost model.
questions.product_responsibility: Optional priorities and budget scope; explain tradeoffs without invented weights.

questions.meaning: What matters most when we compare your options?
questions.ask_only_when: Reuse expressed priorities; ask optionally when it helps an actual tradeoff.
questions.unknown_effect: No forced priorities, click-order weights or mandatory ranking.
questions.product_responsibility: Optional priorities and budget scope; explain tradeoffs without invented weights.

questions.meaning: Who is this coverage for?
questions.source_dependencies: None; integrity guards run before dependent checks.
questions.ask_only_when: Clarify whose facts apply when consequential; reuse unambiguous first-person reports.
questions.unknown_effect: No cross-person transfer or implied sharing authority.
questions.product_responsibility: Requested task, beneficiary and contextual explanation; familiarity never changes fit.

questions.meaning: Where is your permanent home?
questions.ask_only_when: Reuse T03; ask only missing permanent/moving/seasonal meaning relevant to the check.
questions.unknown_effect: ZIP lookup is not proof of residency; preserve multiple places.
questions.product_responsibility: Scope available facts to exact year/geography; preference is not entitlement.

questions.meaning: Which year should we compare?
questions.ask_only_when: Confirm an explicit year only when absent/ambiguous for the requested evidence.
questions.unknown_effect: No substituting 2026 research or unvalidated 2027 samples.
questions.product_responsibility: Scope available facts to exact year/geography; preference is not entitlement.

questions.meaning: Which Medicare parts do you have now?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask actual A/B status for a finding needing it; never equate applied/getting started with active parts.
questions.unknown_effect: Hold dependent entitlement/transition conclusion; learning remains available.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: When did Part B start?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask only if an applicable timing/rights check requires the actual B month.
questions.unknown_effect: No substitution for Part A chronology, birthday or requested start.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: How did you first qualify, or expect to qualify, for Medicare?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask basis/age precision only for an applicable supported rule.
questions.unknown_effect: No inferred birthday, exact eligibility anchor or personal premium.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: How do you get your A and B benefits now?
questions.ask_only_when: Reuse T05/RC04 where sufficient; clarify only actual delivery meaning needed now.
questions.unknown_effect: No forced delivery category or inferred policy identity.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: What changed about your coverage?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask exact change/date only if the requested transition check needs it.
questions.unknown_effect: Keep partial event/date; no inferred window.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: Is this coverage from someone who is still working?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask active-work versus retiree/other source only for relevant coordination/timing.
questions.unknown_effect: Retired status is not retiree insurance; preserve whose employment applies.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: Does the employer have 20 or more employees?
questions.ask_only_when: Use the actual applicable threshold variant only after basis/current-work context is known.
questions.unknown_effect: Unknown/unbound threshold is not a payer-order determination.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: When did the job or coverage end?
questions.ask_only_when: Collect only missing date/precision required by the relevant change check.
questions.unknown_effect: Do not merge jobEnd and coverageEnd or invent exact days.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: Do you have a written notice saying your drug coverage counts as creditable (as good as Medicare’s standard coverage), and has there been a gap?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask the missing notice/period/gap meaning only when relevant; preserve independent known parts.
questions.unknown_effect: Report of notice does not verify coverage; unknown gap cannot yield a penalty finding.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: Could a change affect anyone else’s coverage?
questions.ask_only_when: At an actual relevant change, clarify only missing party/action/effect/period facts; reuse scoped administrator reports.
questions.unknown_effect: Sole-insured status does not establish no impact on own benefits. No automatic consequence or collection of other people details.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: Are you or your employer adding money to an HSA?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask only for a relevant supported contribution/transition check.
questions.unknown_effect: A yes/no cannot decide chronology, retroactivity or tax consequences.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: For the Medigap option you want to explore, what coverage change or notice should we check?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask exact relevant event/notice for the requested Medigap branch; reuse RC05/RC11.
questions.unknown_effect: No generic underwriting/rights assertion from a branch choice.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: Was this your first Medicare Advantage plan, when did it start, and did you have Medigap before?
questions.ask_only_when: Use distinct first-plan/start/prior-policy reports only for relevant rights research.
questions.unknown_effect: History is not verified return/issueability; gaps G01/G04 persist.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: Are you replacing an existing Medigap policy?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask only if replacement is part of the requested comparison/change.
questions.unknown_effect: No inferred exemption, continuation, guaranteed issue or quote.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: Do you currently receive benefits from any of these programs?
questions.ask_only_when: Reuse each named current/pending/unknown program; precision only for affected requested finding.
questions.unknown_effect: Partial program knowledge is retained; no subsidy amount or qualification inference.
questions.product_responsibility: Applicable named assistance and restricted-plan checks; unknown is not ineligible.

questions.meaning: For the Special Needs Plan type you want to explore, what exact qualifying program or plan confirmation do you have?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask only exact relevant qualification report for a requested plan type.
questions.unknown_effect: Unverified/unknown qualification is unresolved, not ineligible; no broad clinical intake.
questions.product_responsibility: Applicable named assistance and restricted-plan checks; unknown is not ineligible.

questions.meaning: Where will you need routine care away from home?
questions.ask_only_when: Reuse T08/places; ask only missing location/type/period needed for routine access.
questions.unknown_effect: Do not flatten multiple destinations or substitute emergency evidence.
questions.product_responsibility: Routine versus emergency care and relevant places/periods.

questions.meaning: What exact office and location should we use for each doctor or hospital?
questions.ask_only_when: Resolve each requested provider site; present identity ambiguity rather than silently selecting a namesake.
questions.unknown_effect: Internal ID/NPI match is not network or appointment verification.
questions.product_responsibility: Exact provider/site identity then separately sourced participation and access.

questions.meaning: What exact name, strength, form, and brand or generic preference should we use for each medicine?
questions.ask_only_when: Resolve product/strength/form only as needed; brand preference remains optional.
questions.unknown_effect: Strength is not quantity/dose; unknown preference does not erase known product facts.
questions.product_responsibility: Product identity, formulary conditions and only relevant fill/store/administration details.

questions.meaning: For each medicine, what quantity, days supply, exact pharmacy and retail or mail order should we use?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask only missing per-item quantity/units/days supply/store/channel needed for a supported requested fill-price, quantity-limit or pharmacy-network finding; no full pricing prerequisite.
questions.unknown_effect: No assumed fill, pharmacy choice or average-as-quote; coverage research may continue.
questions.product_responsibility: Product identity, formulary conditions and only relevant fill/store/administration details.

questions.meaning: Is this given at a clinic or filled at a pharmacy?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask the missing discriminator only when it changes an accepted coverage rule/research target.
questions.unknown_effect: Clinic versus pharmacy alone cannot decide part, device, authorization or a separate problem.
questions.product_responsibility: Product identity, formulary conditions and only relevant fill/store/administration details.

questions.meaning: Is there a monthly amount you want to stay under?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask optionally when the person wants a budget constraint; clarify what the amount includes.
questions.unknown_effect: Unspecified scope cannot yield an all-in affordability/total-cost claim.
questions.product_responsibility: Optional priorities and budget scope; explain tradeoffs without invented weights.

questions.meaning: Which military or veterans’ coverage do you have?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask only missing program subtype relevant to current baseline/coordination.
questions.unknown_effect: Program category is not complete coordination evidence.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: Is there a coverage interruption you need help with now?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask/reuse explicit interruption details only for supported continuity help.
questions.unknown_effect: No invented completed help, coverage cancellation or eligibility finding.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: What should I correct about the specific detail we were discussing?
questions.source_dependencies: None; integrity guards run before dependent checks.
questions.ask_only_when: Apply clear targeted correction directly; ask only actual ambiguity in person/item/field/time.
questions.unknown_effect: No newest-message-wins conflict resolution or acceptance ritual.
questions.product_responsibility: Correct scoped reports and invalidate only dependent findings and recommendations.

questions.meaning: When does the job-based health coverage end?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask only missing coverageEnd; reuse a parent answer to the same field.
questions.unknown_effect: No extra obligation and no substitution for jobEnd.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: When did it start?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask only missing relevant actual Advantage episode start in the parent history context; keep first-entry status distinct.
questions.unknown_effect: No extra obligation; requested future start cannot substitute.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

questions.meaning: Did you have Medigap before it?
questions.ask_only_when: Ask only missing prior Medigap meaning in the parent context.
questions.unknown_effect: No extra obligation or inferred right to return.
questions.product_responsibility: Coverage-path teaching and applicable baseline/transition/rights checks; no universal timing interview.

application_rules: All original question meanings, paths, branches, aliases and optionality remain.
Grouping schedules work, not a new fixed interview or gate.
Source failures are external tasks; never repair them by asking redundant profile questions.
Every conclusion uses finding-specific reported-input and evidence/method/purpose gates.
RC23/RC24 reuse only the details needed for the requested narrow check; full pricing intake is not a prerequisite.
RC13 preserves own group/retiree consequences as well as effects on other people.
Separate later advisor extensions and representation gaps remain governed by the current profile adapter.
